description: This header file defines the interface and registry for SPMD (Single Program Multiple Data) expander classes used in TensorFlow's MLIR-based DTensor system. It includes class declarations for base expander functionality, layout propagation methods, and a registry for managing different expander implementations based on operation names.

classes.name: SPMDExpanderBase
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for SPMD expanders, including methods for expansion and layout computation.

classes.name: SPMDExpanderRegistry
classes.description: Singleton class managing registration and lookup of SPMD expander implementations based on operation names.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Pure virtual method to expand an MLIR operation into its SPMD expanded form.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes output layouts based on input layouts.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Overloaded method that considers both input and output layouts.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutBackward
methods.description: Computes input layouts based on output layouts.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutBackward
methods.description: Overloaded method that considers both input and output layouts.

methods.name: ExpandOpAndSetLayout
methods.description: Runs ExpandOp() and assigns the computed layout to the resulting operation.

methods.name: RunSPMDExpansion
methods.description: Performs the SPMD expansion on a given operation.

methods.name: Global
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the registry.

methods.name: bool IsOpSupported(const std::string & full_op_name)
methods.description: Checks if an operation name is supported by the registry.

methods.name: GetPropagateFnForOp
methods.description: Retrieves the expander associated with a given MLIR operation.

methods.name: GetPropagateFnForFullOpName
methods.description: Retrieves the expander associated with a given operation name string.

methods.name: RegisterPropagateFn
methods.description: Registers an expander for a specific operation name.
